📦 The Official ProjectG Modpack

The Official ProjectG Modpack is a lightweight Vanilla+ Minecraft modpack, optimized for performance and quality of life.

The modpack is designed for the ProjectG Server, but works perfectly fine on other servers and in singleplayer as well.
It keeps the classic vanilla gameplay intact while improving FPS, stability, and overall usability.

🚀 Features

Performance optimizations for smoother gameplay

Quality of Life improvements without changing core mechanics

True Vanilla+ experience

Multiplayer-friendly & server-safe
